notes: Standard WooCommerce shop loop (54 products, 12/page = ~5 pages, 'Näytetään tulokset 1–12 / 54'). Selectors are the standard WooCommerce theme class names (li.product, .woocommerce-loop-product__title, span.price) confirmed by page content/markup patterns (add-to-cart query params, 'Lisää ostoskoriin' buttons) via fetch, but not verified against raw devtools HTML, hence medium confidence. Out-of-stock items show an overlay badge with text 'Loppu varastosta'/'Out of Stock' and their 'Lue lisää' link replaces the add-to-cart button - in_stock left null; treat presence of that badge text or the li carrying WooCommerce's 'outofstock' class as out-of-stock.
